correctness.rationale: For [e1,e2]=e2, the ternary bracket is [x,y,z]=-(x1*y2-x2*y1)z1e2. Expanding the Rota–Baxter defect on eight basis triples produces the four polynomial constraints b(a^2+2ad-bc)=0, b(bc+d^2)=0, b^2(a+d)=0, abc+2ad^2-bcd=0. Independent symbolic Groebner reduction confirms equivalence. If b=0, 2ad^2=0 yields planes A:a=b=0 and B:b=d=0; if b!=0 then d=-a,c=-a^2/b. Inclusion/exclusion counts 3q^2-2q; all determinants vanish. The automorphism group has matrices [[epsilon,0],[r,s]], epsilon=±1,s!=0. For b=0, (a,d) invariant gives zero orbit, nonzero common line, and q-sized plane orbits; b!=0 is one orbit q(q-1); total 2q+1. The inducing binary Lie algebra has only B∪C, so A\B genuinely ternary. Point counts over q^m yield the zeta rational function. Independent exhaustive solutions over F3 and F5 matched 21 and 65.
